# IPC (Integrated Positronic Chassis)
IPCs are fully synthetic humanoids, equipped with a positronic brain that grants them sentience. Unlike organic crew members, IPCs operate on entirely mechanical systems and require unique maintenance procedures.
## Unique Characteristics
IPCs are [color=#1e90ff]completely immune to biological hazards[/color], including: - Toxins and poisons - Radiation exposure (complete immunity) - Disease and viruses - Bleeding - Food and drink requirements - [color=#87ceeb]IPCs do not breathe any air[/color]
### Resistances IPCs have [color=#87ceeb]specialized mechanical features[/color] providing: - [color=#87ceeb]50% resistance to pressure damage (space)[/color] - [color=#87ceeb]Dexterous hands with built-in prying tools (like crowbars, NOT jaws of life)[/color] - [color=#87ceeb]Perform actions 25% faster[/color] (does NOT apply when repairing yourself)
However, they have significant vulnerabilities: - [color=#ff6347]Take 12% extra Brute damage (Blunt/Slash)[/color] - [color=#ff6347]Take 12% extra Heat damage[/color] - [color=#ffa500]Take 15% extra Pierce damage[/color] - [color=#ff6347]Take 200% damage from Shock sources (2x)[/color] - [color=#ff6347]Highly vulnerable to EMPs (stuns, shocks, and damages systems)[/color] - [color=#ffa500]Cannot heal naturally over time[/color] - [color=#ffa500]Can overheat and shutdown if exposed to extreme temperatures[/color] - Require constant power to function
## Temperature Regulation
IPCs have specialized thermal characteristics: - [color=#ffa500]NO active temperature regulation[/color] - unlike organics who warm themselves up, IPCs rely purely on environmental heat sources - [color=#ff6347]Metal chassis conducts heat ~15% faster than organic tissue[/color] - temperature changes more rapidly - [color=#87ceeb]Movement slowdown from cold identical to humans[/color] - [color=#90ee90]CAN warm up in heated environments[/color] (warm rooms, fires, heaters) - [color=#ffa500]Heat damage begins at 325K (52°C)[/color] - [color=#1e90ff]Cold damage begins at 260K (-13°C)[/color]
## Repair and Maintenance
### Physical Damage Repair
IPCs use unique healing methods: - [color=#ffff00]Welders[/color] (must be lit) repair [color=#ff6347]Brute damage[/color] - [color=#1e90ff]Cable coils[/color] repair [color=#ffa500]Burn damage[/color] - Repairs occur over time and will [color=#90ee90]automatically repeat[/color] until fully healed or supplies run out - Each repair cycle uses [color=#ffa500]5 fuel (welder)[/color] or [color=#1e90ff]5 cable (coil)[/color]
[color=#ff6347]Traditional medical supplies like bruise packs and ointment do nothing for IPCs![/color]
## Power Management
IPCs are equipped with an internal power cell that drains over time: - Can recharge from [color=#ffff00]APCs (Area Power Controllers)[/color] by interacting with them - Receive [color=#ffa500]power warnings[/color] when battery runs low - [color=#ff6347]Will shut down completely if power is fully depleted[/color] - Power cell can be removed and replaced by medical staff
[color=#1e90ff]Tip:[/color] Keep an eye on your power levels and plan recharging stops during long operations!
## Combat Considerations
IPCs have distinct tactical strengths and weaknesses:
[color=#90ee90]Advantages:[/color] - Immune to biological warfare (toxins, gas, disease, viruses) - Complete radiation immunity (ideal for nuclear operations) - Complete poison immunity (no bloodstream) - 50% resistance to space pressure (can survive depressurization longer) - No blood loss or bleeding wounds - Dexterous hands with built-in prying tools (crowbars, NOT jaws of life) - Perform actions 25% faster (excludes self-healing with welders/cables) - Can shutdown voluntarily or be rebooted after death - Overheat protection (emergency shutdown prevents circuit death) - Don't need to eat, drink, or breathe
[color=#ffa500]Disadvantages:[/color] - Take 12% extra damage from brute sources (impacts, blades) - Take 12% extra damage from heat sources - Vulnerable to piercing weapons (15% extra damage - circuits exposed) - Tasers and stun batons deal double damage (2x shock) - EMP/Ion grenades stun, shock, and damage systems severely - Cannot heal without specific tools (welders/cable) - Self-healing is NOT faster (25% speed bonus doesn't apply) - No active temperature regulation (can't warm up on their own) - Power dependency creates vulnerability during extended operations - Overheat causes forced shutdown in extreme heat
## Roleplay Notes
IPCs are synthetic beings with positronic brains, giving them unique perspectives: - Often speak in more mechanical or analytical terms - May use binary emotional expressions (0s and 1s) - Question organic behaviors and biological needs - Consider efficiency and logic in decision-making - Have no biological impulses but can develop personality quirks
Remember: IPCs are sentient crew members deserving of the same rights and respect as organic species!
